A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RSMeM research work. All 18 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendix A.1–A.12, support reliable comparison without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original RSMeM evaluations on EarthBench and ThinkGeo, including baseline comparisons, component ablations, case studies and repeated-run results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results in the main text and appendices, including Tables 1–4 and 8–10 and Figures 12–13.

M1.justification: The hierarchical knowledge grounding, instance-indexed failure memory, trajectory compression and iterative refinement procedures remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendix prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same EarthBench coverage and the same 100-question ThinkGeo subset. The modalities, domains and qualitative test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain EarthAgent, Reflexion, ReAct + Simple RAG and ReAct + Web Retrieval. No comparator is added, removed or revised in the main text or appendices.

E3.justification: The backbone configurations, R@1/R@3 procedures, 104-tool setup, metrics and evaluation subsets remain unchanged. Appendix A.10 retains the same ThinkGeo multiple-choice conversion and distractor procedures.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical component ablations, memory-evolution analyses, execution case studies, reflection-overhead analysis and per-domain breakdowns. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.9 and Figure 13 retain three-run DeepSeek-V3.2 results with means and ±1 standard deviation. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains DeepSeek-V3.2 accuracy of 51.82% for EarthAgent R@3 and 57.89% for RSMeM; the appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12 retain the same retrieval, memory-update and evaluation-metric definitions. Neither version adds or revises mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about knowledge-enhanced memory evolution, tool-use performance, answer accuracy and low reflection overhead.

C2.justification: The explanations of component complementarity, backbone effects and domain-specific gains are unchanged. Both versions retain the same limitations concerning knowledge-base coverage, specialized or streaming tasks, and successful but suboptimal traces.

D1.justification: v2 newly documents a ModelScope Studio demo link beneath the title. The existing GitHub link moves from the abstract to this resource row with the same destination; implementation settings and appendix instructions remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, the reference list and the positioning relative to prior remote-sensing agents and memory systems are unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract-ending code-availability sentence is replaced by title-area Code/Demo labels, and the version/date header changes. Research prose and section organization remain unchanged apart from text reflow.

P2.justification: v2 adds an icon-bearing resource row beneath the title, shifting the author block and early-page text layout. Numbered figures and tables retain their content and design; pages 5–18 render identically.

improvement.justification: The prominent code/demo row makes supporting resources easier to discover and adds a documented demo access route, providing a small usability improvement. Scientific content and evidence, including all appendices, remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether the linked demo functions.
